classification: AI-generated marketing key art; not gameplay footage

sourceReferences.role: approved creature-universe visual language and colour reference

generationPrompt.request: Create a premium 5:4 landscape cover showing a portal into another dimension and a wide alien creature universe.
generationPrompt.scene: A dimensional void above the Fend, revealing liquid gravity, crystalline weather, luminous fungal circuitry, folded starlight and floating terrain.
generationPrompt.subjects: Ten to fourteen distinct alien organisms with varied silhouettes, scale, symmetry, material, locomotion and light, centred on the purple-and-gold void-born emblem creature.
generationPrompt.mood: Awe, discovery, intelligence, mystery and hope in deep indigo, violet, cyan and warm gold.
generationPrompt.boundaries: Artwork only; no title, UI, screenshot frame, NASA marks, weapons, gore, horror or watermark. Clearly marketing key art, not gameplay.

refinementPrompt.request: Preserve the portal, central emblem creature, composition, lighting and finish while replacing familiar Earth-animal silhouettes.
replacements: dragon-like form replaced by disconnected gravity arcs orbiting a dark centre
fish-like form replaced by a hollow negative-space organism
cat-like form replaced by a radial many-sided being
winged form replaced by a living weather colony
turtle-like support limbs replaced by levitating stone segments
refinementPrompt.boundaries: No animal anatomy, new typography, title, UI, humans, weapons, gore, horror or watermark.
